text:
**Acme Corp** is a technology company founded in 2010 and headquartered in Austin, Texas. We build cloud-native data infrastructure products used by over 4,000 enterprise clients worldwide.
Our mission: *"To make data accessible, trustworthy, and actionable for every organization."*
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 1. Company Overview

text:
Core hours: **9:00 AM – 5:00 PM local time**, Monday through Friday.
Engineering teams may adopt **flexible hours** with manager approval.
Remote employees must maintain a minimum 4-hour overlap with Austin Core Hours (Central Time).
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 2. Work Schedule and Hours > Standard Hours

text: Non-exempt employees receive 1.5× base pay for hours exceeding 40 per week. Exempt employees are not eligible for overtime pay but may be granted **comp time** at manager discretion.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 2. Work Schedule and Hours > Overtime Policy

text:
| Employment Level | Annual PTO (days) |
|---|---|
| Individual Contributors (L1–L4) | 18 |
| Senior / Staff (L5–L6) | 22 |
| Principal / Distinguished (L7+) | 25 |
| New hire during first 6 months | Accrual only (1.5 days/month) |
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 3. Paid Time Off (PTO)

text: Acme Corp observes **12 federal holidays** plus **2 floating holidays** per year. Employees may carry over a maximum of **5 unused PTO days** to the following year; any balance beyond 5 days is forfeited at December 31.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 3. Paid Time Off (PTO) > Holidays

text: All employees receive **10 paid sick days per year**, separate from PTO. Sick leave does not carry over.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 3. Paid Time Off (PTO) > Sick Leave

text:
Acme Corp covers **90% of the premium** for individual medical coverage and **75%** for dependent coverage. Plans available: Acme Gold PPO, Acme Silver HMO, and HealthShare HSA-Eligible Plan.
The **open enrollment period** runs from **November 1 – November 30** each year. Employees hired mid-year have a 30-day window from their start date.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 4. Benefits > Health Insurance

text:
Dental: 100% covered for preventive care; 80% basic; 50% major.
Vision: One exam per year plus up to $200 for frames/lenses fully covered.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 4. Benefits > Dental and Vision

text: Acme Corp matches **100% of employee contributions up to 4% of salary**. Vesting is immediate on the match. The 401(k) provider is **Fidelity Investments**.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 4. Benefits > 401(k) Retirement Plan

text: All full-time employees at L3 and above receive **RSU grants** vesting over a **4-year cliff-plus-monthly schedule**: 25% vests at the 1-year cliff, then monthly thereafter.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 4. Benefits > Equity (RSUs)

text:
All employees must review and sign the Code of Conduct annually. Key provisions:
**Conflicts of Interest**: Employees must disclose any outside employment or financial interest in a competing company to HR within 14 days.
**Confidentiality**: Proprietary information (source code, customer lists, pricing) must never be shared outside Acme Corp without written authorization from the Legal team.
**Respectful Workplace**: Zero tolerance for harassment, discrimination, or retaliation. Reports go to hr@acmecorp.example.com or the anonymous **EthicsLine** at 1-800-555-ETHICS.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 5. Code of Conduct

text: Acme Corp is a **hybrid-first company**. Engineering, Product, and Design teams may work remotely full-time. Sales, Customer Success, and Operations roles require in-office presence at least **2 days per week**.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 6. Remote Work Policy

text: Remote employees receive a **$1,500 one-time home office stipend** and a company-issued MacBook Pro (M-series) or equivalent Windows laptop upon hire. Equipment must be returned within 5 business days of termination.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 6. Remote Work Policy > Equipment

text: Remote employees are reimbursed up to **$60/month** for home internet access. Submit via the **Concur expense portal** by the last day of the month.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 6. Remote Work Policy > Internet Reimbursement

text:
Acme Corp runs a **bi-annual review cycle**:
**Mid-year calibration**: July (growth check-in, no comp changes).
**Annual review**: January (compensation adjustments and promotion decisions).
**Rating Scale** (1–5):
Below Expectations
Approaching Expectations
Meets Expectations
Exceeds Expectations
Outstanding
An overall rating of **4 or 5** makes an employee **eligible for promotion** in the same cycle. Consecutive ratings of **1 or 2** may initiate a **Performance Improvement Plan (PIP)**.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 7. Performance Reviews

text:
**Acme Academy**: Internal LMS with 200+ courses.
**External Learning Budget**: $2,000 per employee per year (conferences, certifications, books).
**Study Leave**: Employees may take up to 5 days of paid study leave per year for approved professional development.
**Tuition Reimbursement**: Up to $5,250/year for accredited degree programs (must remain employed for 12 months after reimbursement or repay proportionally).
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 8. Learning & Development

text:
**Primary caregiver**: 16 weeks fully paid.
**Secondary caregiver**: 6 weeks fully paid.
Applies to birth, adoption, and foster placement.
Must be taken within **12 months of the qualifying event**.
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 9. Parental Leave

text: Two weeks written notice is expected. Final paycheck issued on the next regular pay date following the last day worked (per applicable state law).
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 10. Separation & Offboarding > Voluntary Resignation

text:
Employees terminated without cause receive severance: **2 weeks pay per year of service**, up to a maximum of **26 weeks**. Benefits continue through the last day of the termination month.
*Questions? Contact HR at hr@acmecorp.example.com or Slack #hr-helpdesk.*
heading_path: Acme Corp Employee Handbook > 10. Separation & Offboarding > Involuntary Termination
